limits: Descriptive overlapping geometry strata, not independent hypothesis tests or outcome-selected thresholds.
Thresholds come from the 381 current selected exposed maps, not every past project map; fresh-map nonoverlap is enforced separately by the experiment harness.
Native static geometry omits champion occupancy, monster wake/aggro, vision, cooldowns and future movement.
Eight-neighbor diagonal corner cutting matches the pinned native distance field; spawn walk is edge-to-edge with walls, holes and altars blocked, not the bot's exact draft-centre path.
Camp clusters are cardinal components of full symmetrically expanded camp positions, not asserted engine group IDs or runtime ownership.
Known bot map-family fingerprints can trigger hardcoded overrides; geometric eligibility is not evidence that a particular branch or champion acted. Actual draftPicks are reported separately.
Procedural geometry, roster size, symmetry and draft can be correlated; subgroup differences do not isolate causal map effects.
Matched native metrics are averaged within map first; controls/opponents and both sides share maps and remain correlated.
Compact policy logs are not used to infer captures or causes of deaths; collected resources and submitted/collected ratios are descriptive.
